_doc: Gate B1 pass criteria for t04 (Gazebo force_torque sensor on ee_joint). Written and committed BEFORE the t04 implementation and flight (2026-11-04); a04 reads every threshold from this file. Must not be edited after the flight. Plan: noc/config/t04_ft_plan.md.

experiment.ft_log: logs/noc/t04_ft_check/ft.log (noc/experiments/log_ft.sh, one line per message: host receive time, TAB, gz.msgs.Wrench JSON)

windows_nominal_s.flight_span: first goto to the land goto (2 s .. 68 s nominal)
windows_nominal_s.note: wall-clock bounds come from the events t04 records at these nominal times

definitions.Fn: normal force = world-x component of the F/T force; body (= ee child frame) to world rotation from pom attitude interpolated at the F/T sample time; F/T sample time on the wall clock = header stamp mapped with the rolling lower envelope of (host receive time - header stamp) over 2 s
definitions.free_std: sample standard deviation of Fn over FREE1
definitions.delta_pre: mean(Fn over CONTACT) - mean(Fn over FREE1)
definitions.delta_post: mean(Fn over CONTACT) - mean(Fn over FREE2)
definitions.expected_sign: Fn_corrected in contact < 0 (wall pushes the tip in -x; child_to_parent = force of ee on base); reported, the gate uses magnitudes and consistency only

C1_recording_and_chain_error_free.rule: ft.log exists, >= 1 message, 0 unparsable lines, logger alive until t04 stopped it; AND meta.abort is null AND meta.error is null AND sum(meta.read_error_counts) == 0 (pending-phase errors of phynt_des / ext_wrench excluded as in t03)

C2_timestamps_continuous_and_fast.rule: over flight_span: header stamps strictly increasing; max consecutive header-stamp gap <= max_gap_s; mean rate (N-1)/(t_last-t_first) > min_rate_hz both on header stamps and on host receive times

C3_bias_measured_in_free_flight.rule: FREE1 holds >= min_samples F/T samples with finite mean and std, AND the tip is free during FREE1: tip surface x (pom position + R * tip centre + radius) <= x_wall - free_margin_m for every pom sample in FREE1

C5_pre_post_consistent.rule: sign(delta_pre) == sign(delta_post) AND ratio_min <= delta_pre / delta_post <= ratio_max
C5_pre_post_consistent.note: same order of magnitude interpreted as within a factor of 3

C6_rotor_safety_and_K_as_t02_t03.rule: meta.safety_version == 2 AND meta.safety equals noc.common.flight.SAFETY AND no safety trip (meta.abort null) AND initial AF equals af_on_baseline.json AND every cycle has a valid get_af_parameters read equal to the baseline (mass, K, B, J; atol 1e-9) AND no set_af_parameters call is made

gate_B1: PASSED iff C1..C6 all hold; otherwise FAILED

reported_not_gated.lag: cross-correlation lag of Fn_corrected against WO efx (phynt.log) and against -uavpos fx, on a 100 Hz wall-clock grid over [contact goto - 2 s, retreat goto + 5 s], search +/- 1 s; positive = the estimate lags the F/T
reported_not_gated.rmse: RMSE of WO efx and of -fx against Fn_corrected after lag compensation, over the same span and over CONTACT
reported_not_gated.bias: F/T force and torque means and std over FREE1 and FREE2 (child frame), Fn bias
reported_not_gated.rtf: real-time factor = header-stamp span / host-time span
reported_not_gated.check_mode_weight: --check: on the ground, mean F/T force norm vs m_ee * g = 0.098 N (+/- 20 %)
reported_not_gated.independence: F/T = physics-engine constraint wrench at ee_joint; it uses no output of the WO/AF/controller chain. WO efx = model-based estimate from rotor speeds and pom state; uavpos fx = controller command. All three respond to the same simulated contact, so they are not independent in time; F/T differs from the wall contact force by m_ee*(a - g) and friction terms.
